foxcart-power-cart-fc1200-1.title: FoxCart Power Cart – 208V-240V 1Ø
foxcart-power-cart-fc1200-1.description: The FoxCart Power Cart features an all-steel chassis frame with three-piece box siding. Handles at each end enable movement, and the power cables can either be wrapped around them or coiled on top of the unit for storage. Both power cables are clamped internally to the frame to reduce strain. Power cable can be coiled on top or wrapped around the handles for easy storage Heavy duty caster wheels that can be locked in place to prevent movement Reverse current protection Output power is adjustable between 24 VDC - 32 VDC in seven (7) position steps Standard FoxCart includes a 50 foot 4/3 wire AC cable with a Hubbell 3100P6W connector and a 15 foot 2/0 DC cable with Anderson aircraft connector.
